faq.question: What does Hikmet mean?
faq.answer: Hikmet is associated with the Arabic form حِكْمَت, whose core sense is hikmet; wisdom (turkish form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Hikmet?
faq.answer: Hikmet is associated with Arabic. Hikmet is the Turkish form of Arabic حِكْمَة (Ḥikma), meaning 'wisdom'.

faq.question: Is Hikmet an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form حِكْمَت is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Hikmet an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Hikmet can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Hikmet a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Hikmet should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ح ك م is Quranic (wisdom), but Ḥikma is not itself a Quranic personal name.
